title: fix(chatbot): redraw record-citation chips after a reload; keep the cited-section scroll to new clicks
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6tp7ABZkjrcw3mEU2eHGpS)_
Fixes #37487
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：使用应用内 AI 的用户，刷新页面或重新打开对话后，回答下方的“引自记录”引用条仍然显示；从引用条打开记录后，再打开命令面板或编辑表单、返回，页面不再被拉回被引的那一节。
- 为什么做：记录 AI 问询专题的引用条跟进卡，原先引用条只在回答当场可见，刷新就消失，无法回头核对出处。
- 出错会怎样：引用条刷新后不显示，或页面多滚一次；记录和对话数据不受影响，撤回本次合并即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Governing text: ruling Q1 on #37144 (draw the persisted, already-verified list; never verify it again); PR #37485 (merged 276174ab0c) and its scope notes on #37487 (S4 on the card, S5 in 7190147175).

- **One allow-list of kept data parts** (`plugin-chatbot/src/toolResultParsers.ts`): `STORED_ANSWER_DATA_PARTS` names the data parts a stored answer keeps through a rebuild, keyed by the message field that carries each between rebuilds: `charts` (`data-chart`, positional) and `recordCitations` (`data-record-citations`). `storedAnswerParts(content, data)` writes them (the charts through the existing `chartAnswerParts`, then the citations list as one part with the stream's part id). It stays in the eager `/core` closure, so the part type is spelled there, not imported from `@objectstack/spec/ai`; a test pins it to `RECORD_CITATIONS_PART_TYPE`.
- **Reader** (`plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts`): `storedAnswerData(parts)` reads every kept part back (`chartsFromParts` + `extractRecordCitations`, the same `RecordCitationsSchema` parse a live part goes through). A refused list is no list.
- **The three rebuilds** now go through those two: the `/ai` history rebuild `hydratedMessagesToChatMessages` (`app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`, reader), the message cache `sanitizeChatMessagesForCache` (`app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts`, writer; `CacheableChatMessage` gains `recordCitations`), and the `useObjectChat` `initialMessages` store rebuild (`plugin-chatbot/src/useObjectChat.ts`, writer). The table names the kept parts; a further kept part takes three edits (the entry, its write in `storedAnswerParts`, its read in `storedAnswerData`).
- **S5** (`app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, `recordSectionAnchor.ts`): the cited-section effect was keyed on the opened-state value or `''`, so any navigation that dropped history state re-ran it and scrolled back. Two parts:
  - within one mount, the key holds the last string value the state carried, replaced only when a new string arrives (state adjusted during render);
  - the booted console showed the record-form overlay (`?form=`) **remounts** the record page without the state, so a component-local memory is not enough. The page now keeps the section it last opened beside the component (`claimCitedSectionOpen`, `{ target: RECORD+ANCHOR, opened: CLICK }`), claimed at the moment the page would move (`focusRecordSection` gains an optional `mayScroll` callback, asked right before scrolling, so an effect re-run before that does not spend it). A redraw at a section already opened marks it again and scrolls nothing. The memory is dropped once no record page has stayed mounted (a zero-delay check after unmount), so a later visit to the same link opens its section again.
- Exports (Clause-②: yes (widening), per seat record 7193217253 S1; level stays patch): `storedAnswerParts`, `STORED_ANSWER_DATA_PARTS` and the types `StoredAnswerData`, `StoredAnswerPart` from `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot/core` and the root; `storedAnswerData` from the root. Named in the changeset.
- Docs: the sentence "a conversation reloaded from history does not redraw them yet" in `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` and `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/README.md` was made false by this change and is rewritten. Changeset `.changeset/37487-citations-survive-reload.md` (patch, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/app-shell`).

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/toolResultParsers.ts`: `STORED_ANSWER_DATA_PARTS` and `storedAnswerParts`.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: `claimCitedSectionOpen` (module level, above the component) and the `sectionOpened` state and effect beside `holdsRouteRecord`.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts`: `sanitizeChatMessagesForCache`.

## Tests

- `app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.recordCitationsReload-37487.test.tsx` (6): server history and cache fallback each restore the chips the live answer draws (same quotes, same order; nothing fetched); a restored server answer re-caches with its list; CONTROL on both paths: a refused part (an alias key) draws nothing and is not cached.
- `plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/useObjectChat.recordCitationsReload-37487.test.tsx` (3): the `initialMessages` store rebuild draws the live chips; CONTROL: a refused list draws nothing (the store part is re-parsed, so the rebuild is no way round the contract); the allow-list entry equals the spec part type.
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.citedSection-37365.test.tsx` (+2, 8 total): after a chip click, a state-dropping `replace` (the `useUrlOverlay` shape) and a pushed overlay followed by Back do not scroll; a pushed overlay that **remounts** the page, and Back, marks the section again and does not scroll; CONTROL in both: a new click after them scrolls. `afterEach` waits one macrotask after `cleanup()` so the page's memory is dropped between cases. `recordSectionAnchor.test.tsx` unchanged, 18/18.
- Ablation, shared allow-list: writer and reader of the citations entry disabled → the three positive path tests fail (3 failed, 6 passed), restored → 9/9. Ablation, S5 in-mount: the key read back off the state as before → that test fails (1 failed, 6 passed). Ablation, S5 remount: `claimCitedSectionOpen` always claims → the remount test fails (1 failed, 7 passed); restored → 8/8.

## Acceptance notes

- N6 / N7 of 7190147175 (the count check, and the empty-reading case opening the field only after the 4 s settle) live in `recordSectionAnchor.ts`'s `locateSection` and are not one line each; they stay open and are carried by #37562.
- On a phone, a chip in the dock sheet opens the record underneath and the sheet stays open over it, so the cited heading is scrolled and marked but hidden until the reader dismisses the sheet. Present since #37485, not changed here; carried by #37556.
- On this boot `/ai/ask/CONVERSATION` resolves into the dock over the app's home page, so the dock and `/ai` were one surface in the browser check.
- N1 of 7193217253: the allow-list jsdoc now says it names the kept parts without driving the code, and cites the test file that pins it.

## Verification

- Local: `pnpm run type-check` in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` and `ui/packages/app-shell`, exit 0. The local whole-suite run of both packages (`vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/app-shell/`) was stopped after 61 min with one failure, which was my own ablation edit made while it ran; the narrowing is declared, and CI's `Test UI` (all shards) is green on e2833f91. Rework head 40bb8ee4 (changeset, jsdoc only): CI check-runs 46 success, 10 skipped before this body edit; the PR-body guards rerun on the edit.
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.recordCitationsReload-37487.test.tsx packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/useObjectChat.recordCitationsReload-37487.test.tsx`, expected 9 passed.
- S4 booted-console check, done on head 039bbc39 (the later head e2833f91 changes one test file only). Showcase app (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`) with the `ui/` console dev server pointed at it, driven by Playwright at 1360x900 and as an iPhone 13. **Injected, not produced**: no producer emits the part before cloud 10c, so the run serves the conversation-history read (`GET /api/v1/ai/conversations/ID`) with an answer carrying a `data-record-citations` part, and, because this boot has no model, serves a one-agent catalog (`GET /api/v1/ai/agents`) so the assistant shows. The cited record is a Field Zoo record whose `markdown`, `html` and `richtext` bodies each hold a cited heading below several screens of text.
  - Chips drawn: 3 (the three quotes), desktop and phone. After a page reload: the same 3, same order.
  - A chip click opens `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_field_zoo/record/ID?section=ANCHOR`; the cited heading is the one marked and sits just under the sticky record header (top 89 px desktop, 45 px phone): `contractor-scope` (markdown), `html-retention` (html), `rich-escalation` (richtext).
  - Refused part (an alias key): 0 chips.
  - S5: scrolled back to the top of the record, opening the command palette (`?palette=1`, replace) and closing it leaves the page there; opening the record form (`?form=ID`, push) and Back leaves the page there (before the remount fix it scrolled back, which is how the remount was found). A probe on `scrollIntoView` records no call.
  - Screenshots: `objectstack-seat5/ai-36996/shots-37487/` in the project files (9 images plus the script).
